decisions.reason: Area elastic sports flooring builds on established in-house production and costs little to keep listed, and there is no evidence after 2019 that its option value has resolved negatively.
Mobile arena floors are a niche project business with uncertain demand after the pandemic, but carrying the system costs little while venue demand recovers.
This second mobile arena system overlaps with B, so it is the likeliest to be consolidated, but without negative evidence keeping the option open is still justified.
Chevron parquet fits the firm's trend-led, natural-aesthetic residential direction and was featured on the home page, so its value looks likely to be realized.
The squash court finish is a small niche far from the residential strategic focus, but it builds on existing surface know-how and costs little to maintain.
Oak skirting is a cheap complementary accessory that supports sales of the sports floor systems, so its carrying cost is low.
